notes.title: NEW Lattice Boss & Game Fixes
notes.content:
I know, I know. I said Friday, but here we are. At least it's only a day late....at least in my timezone.

NEW BOSS: The Legendary Lattice

Some Backstory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316112/f1608e34967fd517f3a6f24e47427b13fdb35764.jpg
So in my personal time, I recently came across this candidate for the Theory of Everything. For the uninitiated, the Theory of Everything is the potential grand equation of the universe from which all of the physical laws (such as gravity, electromagnetism, etc...) are derived. This wonderfully elegant yet flawed theory posits that physical relationships between quantum phenomena have a geometric source, specifically in the form of the extremely complicated E8 lattice. 

I have always had an intense interest in theoretical physics and was so impressed by the paper from which this theory was introduced that I wanted to make a small tribute to the idea. You can read more here: Exceptionally Simple Theory of Everything but it's certainly not required to enjoy the new boss.

Boss Mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316112/1ae3a6af8bd3691d980371ef0b562ecbb612c581.png

The Legendary Lattice exerts a constant quantum gravitational force on the player that can be temporarily disabled by damaging the singularity. Unfortunately, the lattice cannot be truly harmed until the component particles are all annihilated. Be careful because if you raise the particle to a higher energy state, the singularity may pull them in and grow its power making it even harder to escape its irresistible attraction! 

This new boss replaces the second boss, the Abstract. Previously earned achievements will not be affected.

New Sound Manager
Responding to feedback from some blunt but helpful friends, I've normalized the disparity between music and sound effects and added a music mute control to the main menu, It should be easier to play the game now without your ears bleeding which is always preferable.

Bug Fixes

 Single shots and the dash now happen on mouse button down rather than up
 Added constraints to the purple Spiralers so they now no longer spiral up or down off the arena
 Fixed the achievement manager awarding the blizzard achievements during the Circle of Death
 A bunch of little stuff that doesn't warrant mentioning

notes.title: Game Launch & First Update
notes.content:
So we're here....

THE GAME ACTUALLY LAUNCHED! THAT'S AMAZING!

Steam says that people average about 6 minutes of play time which is wayyyyy more than anyone thought possible!

So continuing with the theme of me not knowing what I'm doing, I'm commemorating my first ever launch with my first ever game update. Wednesday, the 5th, I will push out a patch introducing a number of groovy changes such as:


 A volume slider as requested by popular demand!
 A new boss - The Lattice...inspired by the E8 Theory of Everything! Details to follow
 Various balance changes!
 New Achievements!
 A mind-bending secret no one will see coming! Stay Tuned!


Thanks again for everyone supporting this crazy endeavor. I'm hoping that I can parlay this experience into something even grander. I have a real passion for creation and I hope I get a chance to share some of my more insane ideas with the world! 

REFQSE5F

-Tobias
